'''Operations''' was the largest department of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], charged with overseeing all field operations conducted by the organization including straight [[Spy/Legends|spying]], infiltration of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] organizations, blackmail, subversion, and occasionally [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. An assignment to Operations was the most dangerous Intelligence vocation, as operatives would be in direct contact with the enemy. Statistically, an agent entering the field on assignment had a seven percent chance of being either [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action, or captured by the enemy. Fourteen-to-one odds of survival for a single mission were favorable, but field operatives were only allowed to be deployed on twenty missions before they were legally required to retire from the field and take either a desk job or transfer to another department. These operatives had only a twenty-three percent chance of surviving all twenty missions were referred to as "[[23er]]s."

Operations contained three offices; [[Coordinate]], [[Passive Operations]], and [[Systems Operations]].
